stories.title: Draper in Tears as Atmane Ends Montreal Comeback

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Jack Draper in tears in Montreal.

Atmane def. Draper 6-3, 2-6, 6-2.

Wildcard. Bone bruise in the left arm. First Masters 1000 since June.

He fought. He broke down. The US Open (Aug 24) is now a very real question. 💔 #TennisFanrecap #MontrealMasters

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Terence Atmane just ended Jack Draper's latest comeback attempt. 6-3, 2-6, 6-2 in Montreal R1.

The Frenchman: clean, composed, relentless.

Draper won a full set. Then the arm came back.

This one hurts. 🎾 #TennisFanrecap #CanadianOpen

article.headline: Draper Breaks Down in Tears as Atmane Ends Latest Montreal Comeback

stories.title: Navone Saves 11/12 Break Points, Stuns Berrettini in Montreal

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Navone def. Berrettini 6-3, 6-7(5), 6-3 in Montreal R1.

ELEVEN of TWELVE break points saved.

156 minutes. Two days. Rain delay. Didn't matter.

Navone's 19th win of 2026 — a career high. He's not just a clay player anymore. 🔥 #TennisFanrecap #MontrealMasters

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
That Navone-Berrettini stat in Montreal:

🎾 11/12 break points saved

Berrettini created chances all match. Navone refused to break.

On hard courts. Against Matteo Berrettini.

Career-best 19 wins in 2026. More to come? #TennisFanrecap #CanadianOpen

article.headline: Navone Saves 11 of 12 Break Points to Stun Berrettini in Montreal

stories.title: Cincinnati Preview: Alcaraz Returns, Sinner Targets Historic Sweep

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Cincinnati is 8 days away.

Sinner: 5 Masters 1000 in 2026. A 6th would be unprecedented.
Alcaraz: 5 months off. Defending champion. Hungry.
Zverev: French Open won. World No. 2. Chasing No. 1.

This is going to be GOOD. Aug 13. Mark it. 🎾🔥 #TennisFanrecap #CincinnatiOpen
